The one positive signal is the curve profile: 549 buyers, top-3 share of 8%, and a 33% completer share suggest a broad, non-concentrated base rather than a single whale. Graduation at 229 seconds also shows the curve filled quickly.

But the recent behavior cuts against holding demand. The coin is down 79.5% from its 30-minute high and 68.7% over the last 15 minutes, with net flow of -39 SOL and sellers (316) outnumbering the buy-side flow. The first two minutes after graduation had a sell-to-buy ratio near 1.0, and a launch bot was present. Market cap is about $19k with only 54 SOL of pool depth, so a $20 ticket plus fees of 1.4-5.1% would be a meaningful round-trip hit.

Demand that has bled this hard, with sellers still active, does not show evidence that it will persist for the next 30-60 minutes. My recommendation is to skip. A skipped coin costs nothing.
